halloween.costume: a homemade alien costume: a crinkly silver aluminum-foil body wrap held together with visible strips of tape, and a thin lime-green felt headband across the crown of its head, with two bobbing pipe-cleaner antennae rising straight up from the top of its head, tipped with glittery green pom-poms
props: a tiny orange jack-o'-lantern candy pail hanging from a cord around its neck, like a necklace
halloween.caption: Close Encounters of the Bird Kind
